# Dinoy Raj

> Dinoy Raj is an Android developer and conference speaker. He designs and builds focused Android apps in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose on top of Expressive Kit, his own Material 3 Expressive design system, and speaks about on-device AI, custom launchers and agentic Android.

Site: https://dinoyraj.com/
Based in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, India.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dinoyraj.com/): services, featured apps, talks, blogs and contact
- [About Dinoy Raj](https://dinoyraj.com/about): background, what he works on, speaking
- [All apps](https://dinoyraj.com/apps): every Android app, each with its own page (e.g. https://dinoyraj.com/simplelauncher, https://dinoyraj.com/nanopromptground)
- [Talks](https://dinoyraj.com/talks): every session with its abstract and takeaways, and every event
Contact: dinoykraj@gmail.com

## Apps

- [Dino Minimalist Launcher](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dino.simple): a minimalist, text-based Android launcher to reduce screen time. Website: https://minimalistlauncher.com
- [Nano Prompt Ground](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dino.nanoplayground): prompt Gemini Nano offline on an Android phone. Source: https://github.com/dinoy-raj/gemini-nano-playground
- [All apps on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/dev?id=8799251775499093729): also Focus (pomodoro timer), Habbit Tracker, Reel Blocker, App Blocker, Mindful Pause, Notification Blocker, Count down, Meetings, Timeline Calendar, Link Manager and Dynamic Island (in progress).

## Services

- Android apps (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Play Store release)
- App redesigns (Material 3 Expressive, dark theme, motion)
- Design systems (tokens, components, guidelines)
- Icons and visuals (app icons, icon sets, store graphics)
